_note: Disaster claims from June 2026 videos, including the dated Okinawa and July claims. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: A major shaking takes place in Okinawa and a volcano in that area goes off and is seen, and in the month of July a shaking hits the nation and the world, with a crater and people dragging themselves out.
mentions.quote: Watch Okinawa for a major shaking will take place in Okinawa
mentions.falsify_match: A major Okinawa earthquake or eruption, and a significant July disaster.

mentions.claim_text: Putin plays his cards in the days ahead and uses unconventional weapons of war, with a major earthquake coming.
mentions.quote: he'll use unconventional weapons of war
mentions.falsify_match: Russian use of chemical, biological or another unconventional weapon.

mentions.claim_text: A new biological weapon comes out of Cuba, and he says earthquakes will happen that are man-made.
mentions.quote: I saw a new biological weapon... coming out of Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A biological weapons programme traced to Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a 5.3 in eastern Asia as part of what he described and says to watch Hong Kong.
mentions.falsify_match: A significant seismic or political event in Hong Kong.

mentions.claim_text: A silence before the storm, with rings of earthquake seismic activity building.
mentions.falsify_match: A quiet period followed by a major seismic event.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated: no place, magnitude or window.
